**Coaching note:**

You missed a forcing sequence. After Rg8+, Black's king is driven to h7, and then Nxf6 is checkmate—the knight gives mate and the rook covers h8. When you see a loose enemy piece and your rook can give check on the back rank, check first to improve your piece coordination. The check forces the king to a worse square where your knight finishes it.
